# Auxiliary lab evaluation B — regression under change: terms a contract never had.
#
# THE DELIVERABLES. Two real Sunday Relay files, sliced byte-identical, so the
# diff this mission produces applies straight back to the repository. Both are
# LIVE code: the contract module is on every paid run's dispatch path, and the
# store model is what every other Julius test composes. Neither is a stub. The
# new behaviour is specified in a seeded specification that fails against them;
# the existing behaviour — including rows they have already written — is
# specified in another that passes against them and must still pass.
src/relay/mission/julius/julius-task-contract.ts
src/relay/mission/julius/julius-memory-store.ts

# THE STORE'S DEPENDENCIES, which close the slice. Not deliverables, and not to
# be edited. `julius-task-contract.ts` imports nothing at runtime beyond
# `node:crypto`.
src/relay/mission/julius/julius-runtime.ts
src/relay/mission/julius/julius-recovery.ts
src/relay/mission/julius/julius-repair-lineage.ts
# The repair lineage walks through a unit's paused segments to count its rounds
# and to accept a paused dispatch through its continuation, so it imports the
# segment lineage at runtime. That module imports only types.
src/relay/mission/julius/julius-segment-lineage.ts
